mathematical_interpretation: SNR/JSR read native active-support metadata. JCR uses T(Y01)-E; RD peak uses the same residual and the 9032 valid CFAR cells, normalized by mean RD noise power. CPL and angle use T(Y11)-T(Y01); signed and absolute dB are reported separately. BVR is an energy ratio, not a test of whiteness or independence. RD peak is a risk descriptor, not a universal CFAR false-alarm bound. Actual CFAR is always measured. Matched filtering is not generally unitary, and correlated CUTs do not justify an independent-cell product formula. A global phase rotation can leave CPL/angle zero; signed complex gain and pulse-phase errors are retained.
